title: Prune each table to its agreed limit
goal: A daily prune keeps each table within its limit, with a test per table
acceptance: A failing-first test per table with a fake clock
The prune runs before the nightly snapshot so the snapshot holds no expired rows
Rows a running job still needs are kept until the job ends
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: the report sizes prune and forget at 5 h together. Not a measurement.
